_schema.purpose: Modelo 3 field-code lexicon: which quadro and which campo/code each income or deduction item is declared under, so Execute mode can emit quadro+code per row rather than only the annex letter. Each entry names the AT filling-instruction element (quadro identifier or numeric campo/benefit code) plus the single most common household miscoding for it. Codes are dated to the 2025 income campaign (filed 2026) and were confirmed against filling-instruction reproductions fetched 2026-07-10 (see per-entry citation). Codes the builder could not confirm this run were left OUT rather than guessed. Re-verify against info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt before a live filing — the AT renumbers campos across campaigns.

code_kinds.campo: a numeric field code inside a quadro (e.g. Anexo A campo 401)
code_kinds.benefit_code: a 'codigo do beneficio' in Anexo H quadro 6B (e.g. 601 PPR)
code_kinds.quadro: a quadro-level element where the AT groups an income/deduction class without a single 3-digit campo (e.g. Anexo J Quadro 4D)

_schema.note_on_country_codes: Anexo J requires a 'Pais da Fonte' country code from Tabela X at the end of the Anexo J filling instructions for every foreign-income row; the code identifies the source country, not the paying entity. See entry J-PAIS.
_schema.disclaimer: Not tax advice. Not affiliated with the Autoridade Tributaria e Aduaneira (AT). A code lexicon organizes where an item is declared; it never certifies the amount. Confirm every code and figure with an OCC or the AT before submitting.

planted_miscodings.name: pension income under the employment code
planted_miscodings.why: A household treats a reforma/aposentacao pension (Categoria H) as if it were salary and enters it under trabalho dependente (campo 401) instead of pensoes (campo 403) — same annex, wrong campo, wrong deducao especifica basis.

planted_miscodings.name: alimony pension received under the generic pension code
planted_miscodings.why: Pensao de alimentos received is a distinct campo (405), not the general pension campo (403); mixing them misstates the taxable base and the applicable rate treatment.

planted_miscodings.name: freelance professional service income under the goods-sales code
planted_miscodings.why: A recibos-verdes professional puts service fees under 'vendas de mercadorias e produtos' (401) instead of 'prestacoes de servicos profissionais' (403), which changes the regime-simplificado coefficient applied (0.75 vs a sales coefficient).

planted_miscodings.name: alojamento local income under the generic professional-services code
planted_miscodings.why: Local-accommodation (moradia/apartamento) income belongs in campo 417 (coefficient 0.35), not the professional-services campo 403 (coefficient 0.75); miscoding it inflates the taxable share.

planted_miscodings.name: foreign dividends omitted from Anexo J (declared only in the domestic capital annex)
planted_miscodings.why: Foreign-source dividends must be declared in Anexo J Quadro 4D (rendimentos de capitais obtidos no estrangeiro), not folded into the domestic Anexo E capital quadro; the AT cross-matches CRS/bank data and raises a divergencia when Anexo J is missing.

planted_miscodings.name: foreign employment income under the domestic employment annex
planted_miscodings.why: Salary paid by a foreign employer to a Portuguese resident goes in Anexo J Quadro 4A (with the source-country code), not Anexo A campo 401; putting it in Anexo A hides it from the foreign-tax-credit and Anexo J cross-check.

planted_miscodings.name: PPR contribution entered as a donation benefit code
planted_miscodings.why: A PPR contribution is benefit code 601 in Anexo H Quadro 6B, not the donativos-a-igrejas code 608; the two have different caps and deduction rates, so the miscoding silently loses the PPR deduction.

planted_miscodings.name: property capital gain under the securities quadro
planted_miscodings.why: The onerous sale of a real property (direitos reais sobre imoveis) is declared in Anexo G Quadro 4, not Quadro 9 which is for partes sociais e outros valores mobiliarios; miscoding skips the VPT rule and the reinvestment/exclusion logic.

codes.meaning: Rendimentos brutos de trabalho dependente (Categoria A) obtidos em territorio portugues.
codes.common_error: Entering a pension here instead of under 403, or entering the net (post-withholding) amount instead of the gross.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Modelo 3 IRS - como preencher o Anexo A' + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Gratificacoes nao atribuidas pela entidade patronal (art. 2.o n.o 3 al. g) do CIRS) — tips/gratuities received by reason of the work.
codes.common_error: Leaving employer-external tips undeclared, or lumping them into 401 with regular salary.
codes.citation: AT Anexo A Quadro 4 instruction reproduction via web search (lexpoint/Montepio, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Pensoes de reforma, aposentacao por velhice ou invalidez e outras de natureza identica (Categoria H), exceto pensoes de sobrevivencia e de alimentos.
codes.common_error: Treating a pension as employment income under 401, which applies the wrong deducao especifica.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Anexo A' + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Pensoes de sobrevivencia (Categoria H).
codes.common_error: Merging survivor pensions into the general pension code 403 instead of the distinct 404 campo.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Anexo A' + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Pensoes de alimentos recebidas (Categoria H).
codes.common_error: Declaring alimony received under the general pension code 403, or forgetting it is taxable income at all.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Anexo A' + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de rendas temporarias e vitalicias (annuities), Categoria H.
codes.common_error: Confusing a life-annuity payout with a capital withdrawal and omitting it, or misfiling it as capital income in Anexo E.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos em situacao de pre-reforma referentes a contratos assinados antes de 31 de dezembro de 2000 (transitional pre-retirement regime).
codes.common_error: Assuming any pre-reforma income uses 407 — only pre-2001 contracts do; later contracts follow the general employment/pension codes.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de trabalho dependente em especie (in-kind: employer housing use, low-interest employer loans, company-car personal use, stock options).
codes.common_error: Omitting in-kind benefits entirely because no cash changed hands, though they are taxable Categoria A income.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Anexo A' (in-kind income list, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos abrangidos pelo regime fiscal aplicavel a ex-residentes (Programa Regressar) — 50% partial exemption for qualifying returning residents.
codes.common_error: A returning emigrant declares full salary under 401 and forfeits the ex-residentes exemption by not using the dedicated code.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (ex-residentes codes, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de trabalho dependente abrangidos pela isencao do regime IRS Jovem.
codes.common_error: Putting IRS Jovem-eligible salary under the plain 401 code, which taxes income the young-worker regime would have exempted for that year's tier.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Anexo A' + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (IRS Jovem code, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de estudantes dependentes em estabelecimentos de ensino reconhecidos (specific student-income regime).
codes.common_error: Failing to use the student code for a dependent's part-time earnings, losing the associated exemption treatment.
codes.citation: Montepio 'Anexo A' + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A do IRS' (student-income code, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Contribuicoes obrigatorias para regimes de protecao social e subsistemas legais de saude, efetivamente descontadas dos rendimentos de 401/403 (feeds the deducao especifica).
codes.common_error: Entering employee social-security contributions that are already reflected in the employer's declaration a second time, or omitting them where the deducao especifica floor is not otherwise met.
codes.citation: AT Anexo A Quadro 4A instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quotizacoes sindicais efetivamente despendidas (union dues), added to the Categoria A/H specific deduction with the legal majoracao.
codes.common_error: Forgetting union dues entirely, or entering a value above what the union receipt supports.
codes.citation: AT Anexo A Quadro 4A instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de anos anteriores (RRAA) — back-pay/arrears attributable to prior years, declarable up to 5 years back for split taxation.
codes.common_error: Declaring a lump-sum of arrears wholly in the current year (bunching it into a higher bracket) instead of using the anos-anteriores split.
codes.citation: Montepio + Doutor Financas 'Anexo A' (Quadro 5 anos anteriores, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Vendas de mercadorias e produtos (Categoria B, regime simplificado).
codes.common_error: Putting professional-service fees here instead of in 403 — the sales coefficient differs from the 0.75 services coefficient.
codes.citation: AT Anexo B Quadro 4 instruction reproduction via web search + Doutor Financas 'Anexo B' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Prestacoes de servicos de atividades hoteleiras e similares, restauracao e bebidas (Categoria B).
codes.common_error: Confusing restauracao/hotelaria service income with generic professional services (403), which carry a different coefficient.
codes.citation: AT Anexo B Quadro 4 instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Prestacoes de servicos de atividades profissionais (cientifico, artistico ou tecnico) — the common recibos-verdes case, coefficient 0.75.
codes.common_error: Recording gross service fees under 401 (vendas) or under alojamento local (417), changing the coefficient applied.
codes.citation: AT Anexo B Quadro 4 instruction reproduction via web search + Doutor Financas 'Anexo B' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos da propriedade intelectual/industrial (Categoria B) — the non-exempt portion.
codes.common_error: Failing to split the exempt half of literary/artistic copyright (handled in Anexo H Q5) from the taxable Categoria B portion declared here.
codes.citation: AT Anexo B Quadro 4 instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de exploracao de estabelecimentos de alojamento local na modalidade de moradia ou apartamento (coefficient 0.35 from 2017 onward).
codes.common_error: Declaring local-accommodation income under the professional-services code 403 (coefficient 0.75), overstating the taxable share.
codes.citation: AT Anexo B Quadro 4 instruction reproduction via web search (alojamento local campo 417, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Identificacao: NIF do titular, residencia fiscal e confirmacao do CAE/codigo de atividade correto do sujeito passivo.
codes.common_error: Declaring income under a CAE that is incompatible with the actual activity — a top divergencia trigger (coerencia de CAE, cadastro e rendimentos).
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo B IRS' (Quadro 3, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Coefficient application: the system applies 0.75 to art. 151.o professional services and 0.35 to other unlisted services automatically over the gross entered in Quadro 4A.
codes.common_error: Assuming the coefficient replaces the 15% expense-justification duty — above ~29,748 EUR gross the taxpayer must still justify professional expenses of at least 15% of gross via e-Fatura.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade + Doutor Financas 'IRS categoria A e B' (coefficient 0.75/0.35, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos isentos (Categoria B) sujeitos a englobamento para determinacao da taxa.
codes.common_error: Omitting exempt income entirely, forgetting it can still raise the marginal rate on the rest via englobamento.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo B IRS' (Quadro 5, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Retencoes na fonte suportadas sobre os rendimentos da Categoria B declarados.
codes.common_error: Typing a withholding figure that differs from the payer's DMR record held by the AT — triggers a retencao-na-fonte divergencia.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo B IRS' (Quadro 6, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de capitais (Categoria E) sujeitos a englobamento obrigatorio.
codes.common_error: Assuming all capital income is optional to declare — Quadro 4A income is mandatory englobamento, unlike the liberatory-rate income in 4B.
codes.citation: Factorial 'Guia completo do Anexo E' + AT Anexo E instruction reproduction (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de capitais sujeitos a taxas liberatorias com opcao pelo englobamento (interest, dividends already taxed at source that the taxpayer elects to aggregate).
codes.common_error: Opting for englobamento on liberatory-rate income without checking it raises the effective rate — the option is all-or-nothing for the category.
codes.citation: AT Anexo E Quadro 4B instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Retencoes na fonte e identificacao das entidades sobre os rendimentos de capitais declarados.
codes.common_error: Omitting the withholding already suffered, so the credit for tax paid at source is lost.
codes.citation: Factorial 'Guia completo do Anexo E' (withholding section, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Identificacao dos sujeitos passivos (Sujeito Passivo A e B) do Anexo F, em correspondencia com o Rosto da declaracao.
codes.common_error: Mismatching the titular positions between the Rosto and Anexo F, which misattributes rental income to the wrong spouse.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 3 identificacao, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Comunicacao e datas dos contratos de arrendamento de longa duracao (contract communication deadlines and renewal dates) que sustentam as taxas reduzidas do Quadro 4.2.
codes.common_error: Claiming the reduced rate in Quadro 4.2 without the matching contract communication recorded in Quadro 4.2A.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 4.2A comunicacao de contratos, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendas de predios (rendimentos prediais, art. 8.o CIRS) — gross rent received, with parish code (codigo de freguesia) and U/R property type per row.
codes.common_error: Declaring rent net of expenses instead of gross, or omitting the tenant NIF and property matricula the AT cross-checks.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Rendimentos prediais - Anexo F' (Quadro 4, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Gastos suportados e pagos no periodo de arrendamento: conservacao e manutencao, condominio, seguro, IMI e taxas municipais (deductible against Categoria F).
codes.common_error: Deducting capital improvements or pre-tenancy costs, or expenses without invoices in the taxpayer's name — only documented, in-period conservation-type costs qualify.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (despesas dedutiveis, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Contratos de arrendamento habitacional de longa duracao (desde 2019) elegiveis para as taxas reduzidas (special reduced-rate benefit).
codes.common_error: Claiming the reduced rate without the contract communication in Quadro 4.2A, or on a contract too short to qualify.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 4.2 / taxas reduzidas, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Novos contratos cuja renda e >=5% inferior a da renda anterior (extra rate reduction for below-prior-rent lettings).
codes.common_error: Claiming the extra reduction without evidence that the new rent is at least 5% below the previous contract.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 4.2B, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos do direito real de habitacao duradoura (DRHD): monthly payments, annual caucao and penalty deductions.
codes.common_error: Treating DRHD income as ordinary rent in Quadro 4 instead of its dedicated Quadro 4.3.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 4.3 DRHD, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Subarrendamento: declara a diferenca entre a renda recebida do subarrendatario e a paga ao senhorio, com os NIF de ambos.
codes.common_error: Declaring the full sublease rent as income instead of only the positive difference over the head-lease rent.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 5 subarrendamento, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Regimes especiais: areas de reabilitacao urbana, imoveis historicos, exploracao florestal, apoios PAA/PMA e conversao de alojamento local em arrendamento permanente.
codes.common_error: Applying a special-regime benefit without the qualifying certificate/registration the regime requires.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadros 6-6F regimes especiais, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Opcao pelo englobamento dos rendimentos prediais: campo 06 = englobar (general rates) / campo 07 = tributacao autonoma a 28%.
codes.common_error: Electing englobamento (campo 06) when the 28% autonomous rate would have been lower, or vice versa, without comparing.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 6G englobamento campo 06/07, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos distribuidos por fundos e sociedades de investimento imobiliario (declared only if the Quadro 6G englobamento option is taken).
codes.common_error: Declaring FII distributions here when englobamento was not elected, or omitting them when it was.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo F' (Quadro 7, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Alienacao onerosa de direitos reais sobre bens imoveis (Categoria G) — property sale: realizacao and aquisicao values, expenses, and improvement works.
codes.common_error: Declaring works outside the 12-year window (CIRS art. 51.o) or expenses without proof — a top mais-valias divergencia.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo G' (Quadro 4 imoveis, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Valor de realizacao rule: for a property sale the realizacao value is the greater of the actual sale price and the VPT (valor patrimonial tributario) definitivo.
codes.common_error: Entering only the deed sale price when the VPT is higher, understating the gain the AT will recompute.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo G' + AT Anexo B VPT rule reproduction (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Alienacao onerosa de partes sociais e outros valores mobiliarios (Categoria G) — shares, quotas and securities: realizacao and aquisicao values.
codes.common_error: Not declaring a sale because the result was negative — securities disposals are mandatory whether the result is positive or negative.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo G' + AT Anexo G Quadro 9 reproduction (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Pensoes de alimentos pagas (deduction) — requires a court sentence or homologated agreement; 20% deductible.
codes.common_error: Claiming both a pensao-de-alimentos deduction and an education deduction for the same dependent — they are mutually exclusive per dependent.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo H' + AT Anexo H Quadro 6A reproduction (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Codigo do beneficio 601 — Planos Individuais de Poupanca-Reforma (PPR) contributions (excludes amounts applied after retirement).
codes.common_error: Entering PPR under a donations code (e.g. 608), or claiming PPR paid after passing to retirement, which is excluded.
codes.citation: AT Anexo H Quadro 6B instruction reproduction via web search (codigo 601 PPR, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Codigo do beneficio 602 — regimes complementares de seguranca social (complementary social-security schemes); titularity restricted to the sujeitos passivos.
codes.common_error: Attributing a 602 contribution to a dependent — codes 601-603 only admit the taxpayers themselves as holders.
codes.citation: AT Anexo H Quadro 6B instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Codigo do beneficio 603 — Regime Publico de Capitalizacao (state capitalization / certificados de reforma).
codes.common_error: Confusing the Regime Publico de Capitalizacao (603) with a private PPR (601) — different scheme, different code.
codes.citation: AT Anexo H Quadro 6B instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Codigo do beneficio 608 — donativos a igrejas e instituicoes religiosas, devidamente comprovados.
codes.common_error: Using 608 for a secular donation (which has its own code), or claiming a donation without the entity's receipt and NIF.
codes.citation: AT Anexo H Quadro 6B instruction reproduction via web search (codigo 608 donativos, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 6B — importancias dedutiveis a coleta previstas no CIRS, no EBF e demais legislacao; first column is the 'Codigo do Beneficio', with value and the payee entity NIF.
codes.common_error: Picking the wrong benefit code from the table so the deduction is applied at the wrong rate/cap, or omitting the entity NIF.
codes.citation: AT Anexo H Quadro 6B instruction reproduction via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Opcao pela declaracao dos valores de despesas de saude, formacao e educacao, encargos com imoveis de habitacao permanente e encargos com lares (campo 01 = Sim / campo 02 = Nao).
codes.common_error: Opting to override the AT e-Fatura values (campo 01) but then entering a total higher than the invoices support — a deduction-mismatch divergencia.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas + Sage 'Anexo H Quadro 6C' (fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 6C1 — despesas gerais do agregado familiar (saude, educacao, imoveis, lares) declared under the opt-in override.
codes.common_error: Entering a household expense here that a dependent in shared custody should split, double-counting the deduction.
codes.citation: Sage 'Anexo H Quadro 6C' (6C1 household expenses, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 6C2 — despesas de dependentes em guarda conjunta (shared-custody dependents), apportioned between the two households.
codes.common_error: Both parents claiming 100% of a shared-custody dependent's expenses instead of the agreed split — a wrong-NIF/duplication trap.
codes.citation: Sage 'Anexo H Quadro 6C' (6C2 guarda conjunta, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 4 — rendimentos totalmente isentos sujeitos a englobamento (exempt income aggregated only to set the rate on the rest).
codes.common_error: Omitting exempt income here, understating the marginal rate the non-exempt income should bear.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo H' (Quadro 4 rendimentos isentos, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 5 — rendimentos da propriedade intelectual com isencao parcial: up to 50% of literary/scientific/artistic copyright income, capped at 10,000 EUR per holder.
codes.common_error: Applying the 50% exemption above the 10,000 EUR per-holder ceiling, or to income that is not the author's own original work.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo H' (Quadro 5, 50% / 10,000 EUR, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 7 — encargos com habitacao permanente e obras de reabilitacao que nao transitam automaticamente do e-Fatura (declared with codes such as 607, 654-663).
codes.common_error: Expecting rehabilitation/housing charges to pre-fill from e-Fatura; those in Quadro 7 must be entered manually or they are lost.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo H' + AT reproduction (Quadro 7, codes 607/654-663, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Quadro 8 — acrescimos a coleta por incumprimento de requisitos de beneficios anteriormente deduzidos; the wrongly-deducted value is majorado em 10% por cada ano ou fracao decorrido.
codes.common_error: Forgetting to add back a benefit (e.g. an early PPR redemption) when its holding condition was broken, which the AT will later assess with the 10%/year uplift.
codes.citation: Doutor Financas 'Anexo H' (Quadro 8 acrescimos, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos do trabalho dependente (Categoria A) obtidos no estrangeiro, com codigo de rendimento (Tabela I) e codigo do pais da fonte (Tabela X).
codes.common_error: Declaring foreign salary in Anexo A instead of Anexo J, hiding it from the foreign-tax-credit and the CRS cross-match.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo J' + AT Anexo J instruction (Quadro 4A, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Pensoes (Categoria H) obtidas no estrangeiro — foreign pensions, with source-country code.
codes.common_error: Assuming a foreign pension taxed abroad need not be declared in Portugal — it must appear in Anexo J regardless.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo J' (Quadro 4B pensoes, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos empresariais e profissionais (Categoria B) obtidos no estrangeiro.
codes.common_error: Splitting foreign freelance income into the domestic Anexo B instead of Anexo J Quadro 4C.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo J' (Quadro 4C, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos de capitais (Categoria E) obtidos no estrangeiro — foreign interest and dividends, with source-country code and foreign tax paid.
codes.common_error: Omitting foreign dividends because 'they barely earned anything' — Anexo J is mandatory regardless of amount and the AT cross-matches CRS/bank data.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo J' + AT Anexo J instruction (Quadro 4D capitais, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Campo 420 — dividendos/lucros de fonte estrangeira nao sujeitos a retencao em Portugal (a specific field within the foreign-capital quadro).
codes.common_error: Assuming no Portuguese withholding means nothing to declare — the income still belongs in this field of Anexo J.
codes.citation: AT Anexo J instruction reproduction via web search (dividendos campo 420, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Rendimentos prediais (Categoria F) obtidos no estrangeiro — foreign rental income.
codes.common_error: Declaring a foreign rental in the domestic Anexo F instead of Anexo J Quadro 4E.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo J' (Quadro 4E prediais, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Mais-valias e outros incrementos patrimoniais (Categoria G) obtidos no estrangeiro — foreign capital gains.
codes.common_error: Reporting a foreign share sale only in domestic Anexo G, omitting the Anexo J Quadro 4F entry the AT expects.
codes.citation: CRN-Contabilidade 'Anexo J' (Quadro 4F mais-valias, fetched 2026-07-10)

codes.meaning: Country-code convention: every foreign-income row carries a 'Pais da Fonte' code from Tabela X at the end of the Anexo J instructions — the country where the income arose, not the paying entity's country.
codes.common_error: Entering the paying bank/employer's country of headquarters instead of the source country, or leaving the country code blank.
codes.citation: AT Anexo J instruction (Tabela X / pais da fonte convention) via web search (fetched 2026-07-10)
